_about: Nitrogen (1) + methanol (2): total pressure and liquid mole fraction of nitrogen at 273.15, 298.15, 323.15 and 343.15 K, 4.9-29.5 MPa, from Krichevskii and Lebedeva (1947), as compiled in IUPAC SDS Vol. 10.

source.citation: I. R. Krichevskii, E. S. Lebedeva, [nitrogen + methanol at high pressure: the compiled sheet gives no title and the article has no DOI], Zh. Fiz. Khim. 21 (1947) 715-717
source.access: The original article is not open; its values are compiled in IUPAC Solubility Data Series Vol. 10, Nitrogen and Air (R. Battino, ed., Pergamon, 1982; copyright IUPAC), which IUPAC publishes as open access at iupac.github.io
source.tables: IUPAC Solubility Data Series Vol. 10 (1982) p 446 (PDF p 491), prepared by C. L. Young; P printed in bar, converted to kPa (x 100); estimated error (compiler) T 0.1 K, P 0.5 %, x 1 % (U_P_kPa and U_x_1 hold these). Method 'not clear from original paper'; the nitrogen contained 0.4 mol % oxygen; methanol purity better than 99.9 mol %. The only high-pressure set of nitrogen + methanol in the volume.
source.transcription: Read from the scanned page image (rendered at 110 dpi) and the PDF's text layer, which agree value by value. The person checking should compare each row with the page.

notes: P_printed is the pressure in bar as printed; P_kPa = 100 P_printed. No vapour compositions. To be checked by a person against the page (AGENTS.md rule 4).
